newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish consortium bids for PBK bank.
newsitem.headline: Polish consortium bids for PBK bank.

text.p: A consortium of three Polish banks and an insurance firm has placed a bid for a 51-percent stake in state-owned Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK), the firms said in statements on Tuesday.
The consortium , which groups the Polish Development Bank (PBR), Bank Przemyslowo -Handlowy (BPH), Kredyt Bank and insurer Warta, submitted its offer to the treasury on Monday, the statements said.
The state treasury wants to sell up to 65 percent of PBK shares to a strategic investor or to a group of investors. Monday was the deadline for placing bids.
Another 15 percent of PBK is likely to be sold in a public offer in the fourth quarter of the year.
Investment bank HSBC, which advises in the PBK sale, estimated PBK's value at between 1.2 and 1.6 billion zlotys.
Banking sources earlier said Citibank and South Korea's Samsung were also interested in buying stakes in PBK.
